text:
Priya S. (Finance Ops): FYI we received INV-SA-2026-221 from SentinelAI for €9,800 but the PDF header has no PO and it shows 20% VAT. Vendor says payment due in 14 days. Can procurement confirm PO mapping and tax treatment?
Invoices Bot: New invoice uploaded: INV-SA-2026-221 \u2022 amount €9,800 \u2022 status: unmatched. Link: https://accounting.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-SA-2026-221
Elena (Procurement): Looking now  we have PO-86753 issued in USD ($10,000) for Sentinel reserved model calls. No EUR PO in system. That explains the mismatch.
Sentinel Billing: Hi team  invoice auto-generated in EUR due to regional billing profile. We referenced PO-86753 in our system but it didn't render on the PDF because of the currency switch. VAT added per EU rules  we applied local VAT at 20%.
Marco (Tax): Quick tax note: Redwood is VAT-exempt for EU B2B if we provide our EUID (VAT ID) and reverse-charge applies. Do we have Sentinel's request for our VAT ID? If yes they can reissue without VAT.
Priya S. (Finance Ops): We have Redwood VAT ID: GB999888777 on file, but SAP vendor record might not have it set for this supplier. AP can't match without PO on header and correct VAT treatment.
Rohan (AP): AP requires PO on the invoice header (or seperate matching sheet) and correct legal entity and tax lines. If vendor reissues without VAT and shows PO-86753 we can match to the USD PO after FX conversion note.
Elena (Procurement): Two paths: 1) Procurement asks vendor to reissue INV-SA-2026-221-R1 in USD referencing PO-86753 (amount in USD) and no VAT; 2) Vendor reissues in EUR with PO-86753 and includes the FX rate and reverse-charge note plus our VAT ID. Which is easier for vendor?
Sentinel Billing: We can do either. Reissuing in USD requires internal routing and may take extra day. Adding reverse-charge + VAT ID and PO on EUR PDF is faster. We can upload INV-SA-2026-221-R1 today with PO-86753 on header, include reverse-charge note and remove VAT.
Marco (Tax): Prefer the reverse-charge approach; ensures accounting continuity and avoids a new PO. Please ensure the invoice explicitly states: "Reverse charge - VAT to be accounted by the recipient (Article X)" and includes Redwood VAT ID.
Priya S. (Finance Ops): Also please ensure the invoice shows the original EUR amount and a note of the exchange rate used if needed for bookkeeping. AP needs FX reference when matching to USD PO.
Rohan (AP): Once invoice has PO and reverse-charge note we can match committed amount to PO-86753 (system will do FX allocation). If any delta due to FX we'll route to cost owner.
TaxBot: Reminder: invoices >5k in foreign currency require tax review. Routing to @Marco triggered.
Anika (Finance Manager): Routing note: If final matched amount exceeds $15k after FX, route to me. For now proceed with vendor reissue and Marco review.
Sentinel Billing: Reissued invoice uploaded: INV-SA-2026-221-R1 \u2022 amount €9,800 \u2022 note: PO-86753 on header; reverse-charge applied; Redwood VAT ID GB999888777 included. Link: https://accounting.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-SA-2026-221-R1
Invoices Bot: Invoice INV-SA-2026-221-R1 uploaded \u2022 status: pending match.
Rohan (AP): Received. Matched to PO-86753 pending FX check. Routing tax note to Marco for confirmation of reverse-charge correctness.
Marco (Tax): Reviewed the reissue. Reverse-charge wording and VAT ID present. This is okay from a tax perspective. No VAT due to Redwood. Approve routing.
Rohan (AP): AP matched the EUR invoice to PO-86753 at the FX rate noted on the invoice. Small FX variance of $120 routed to cost owner Suresh K. for acceptance.
Priya S. (Finance Ops): Suresh confirmed acceptance of $120 variance. Routing to Anika not required. Approve payment scheduling.
Anika (Finance Manager): Confirmed. Clear for payment. Please document vendor change request: ensure future invoices include PO even when currency differs and include VAT ID for EU B2B.
Sentinel Billing: Thanks for the fast turnaround. We'll update billing profile to always render po_number when present and include reverse-charge handling for EU corporate customers.
Priya S. (Finance Ops): Closing ticket: "Sentinel invoice currency/tax mismatch: reissued INV-SA-2026-221-R1 with PO-86753 and reverse-charge; VAT ID included; matched to PO; FX variance $120 accepted; payment approved." :white_check_mark:
